'''''Star Wars Jedi: Battle Scars''''' is a [[canon]] novel featuring [[Cal Kestis]] set between the [[Star Wars video games|video game]]s ''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]'' and ''[[Star Wars Jedi: Survivor]]''. The novel was written by [[Sam Maggs]] and published by [[Random House Worlds]] on [[March 7]], [[2023]].
